# PicoDrive upstream source reference

ZZPicoDriveMD 1.1 was built against:

PicoDrive repository: https://github.com/notaz/picodrive
PicoDrive commit: 26ecb2b6358fefba24e3d68b9eb2efba7f10d5ee

Cyclone 68000 repository: https://github.com/irixxxx/cyclone68000
Cyclone commit: 3ac7cf1bdeecb60e2414980e8dc72ff092f69769

The exact upstream source archives for both revisions are physically included in:

source/third_party/archives/

PicoDrive's original COPYING and AUTHORS files are preserved inside the
PicoDrive archive. Cyclone's original license files and generator sources are
preserved inside the Cyclone archive.

Cyclone.s is generated from the Cyclone generator sources by the upstream
Makefile and is not stored in the Cyclone repository at this revision.

The root COPYING_PICODRIVE.txt is a convenient copy of the PicoDrive license
text applicable to this release.
